---
title: Vega smoke report
format: html
---

A Quarto 2 document of the project, as `report.qmd` is a Quarto 1 one. Its cells take run arrows,
as a script's statements do, and the arrow on line 1 previews the document.

## Origins

::: {.callout-note}
The heavy cars of each origin, from `data/summaries.av.sql`, in @fig-origins.
:::

```{avenger-sql}
--| label: fig-origins
--| fig-cap: Heavy cars by origin
FROM heavy_by_origin
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => Origin, y => cars) AS chart
```

## Weather

The wet days of each weather, then their chart. A day is wet when $p > 0$:

$$
\text{wet} = \{\, d : p_d > 0 \,\}
$$

```{avenger-sql}
FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS days GROUP BY weather;

FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => weather, y => COUNT(*), title => title('Wet days', syntax => 'plain_lines')) AS chart
```
